name: yeli
description: A local-first Markdown workspace carried by one editable HTML file.

scripts.build:single:all: npm run build:single:zh-CN && npm run build:single:en
scripts.build:single:advanced:zh-CN: tsc -b && YELI_SINGLE_FILE=1 YELI_ADVANCED_PLUGIN=1 YELI_STARTER_LOCALE=zh-CN vite build
scripts.build:single:advanced:en: tsc -b && YELI_SINGLE_FILE=1 YELI_ADVANCED_PLUGIN=1 YELI_STARTER_LOCALE=en vite build
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:single:all && vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:advanced: npm run build:single:advanced && YELI_TEST_ADVANCED=1 vitest run tests/integration/advanced-profile.test.ts && YELI_TEST_ADVANCED=1 playwright test tests/browser/advanced-profile.spec.ts --project=chromium-desktop
scripts.test:browser:webkit: npm run build:single:all && YELI_FORCE_WEBKIT=1 playwright test --project=webkit-desktop --project=webkit-mobile
scripts.test:agent: node scripts/test-agent-fixtures.mjs && vitest run tests/unit/agent-operations.test.ts tests/integration/agent-file-edit.test.ts tests/integration/agent-parity.test.ts
scripts.test:wysiwyg: vitest run tests/unit/block-projection.test.ts tests/integration/wysiwyg-fidelity.test.tsx && playwright test tests/browser/wysiwyg-input.spec.ts
scripts.verify:site: npm run build:single:all && npm run build:site && npm run check:site
scripts.package:site: npm run verify:site && npm run test:site && node site/scripts/package.mjs
